title: Mmaba yo o tukang
intro: Mo malatsing a ntlha a tshenolo, go ne ga tlhaga setshwantsho sengwe e le moganetsi yo o tlhogoethata wa boammaaruri. E re ka moya ono o ne o segofaditswe ka khumo le maemo, o ne wa tlhopha go ikgogomosa go na le go kaelwa, mme kgang ya bone e ne ya nna tlhagiso e e tlhamaletseng mo ditemaneng tsa bofelo tsa surah.
clues: Ke ne ke nna mo motseng o le mongwe le Moporofeti, mme ke ne ke le mo gare ga ba losika lo lo gaufi thata le ene, le fa go ntse jalo boikgogomoso jwa me bo ne jwa dira gore ke nne kgakala le boammaaruri.
Ke ne ke na le khumo e ntsi le dithoto tse dintsintsi, mme ke ne ke akanya gore dithoto tsa me di tla nna di ntshireletsa ka metlha.
Fa molaetsa o senolwa, ke ne ka o sotla phatlalatsa mme ka fapoga, ke itsaya ke le kwa godimo ga badumedi.
Bobaba jwa me bo ne bo itsege thata jaana mo e leng gore surah nngwe ya Quran e ne ya bua le nna ka tlhamalalo, e mpitsa ka leina le ba bangwe ba neng ba nkitse ka lone.
Ke ne ka tlhagisiwa gore khumo ya me le madi a ke neng ke a bona ga di kitla di nthusa, mme ke ne ke tla latlhelwa mo molelong o o tukang.
Ke itsege jaaka rraagwe kgabo, mme mosadi wa me o tla rwala dikgong tsa molelo ka thapo ya tlhale ya palema mo molaleng wa gagwe.

trial.answer: O ne a gana Boiselamo mme a ganetsa Moporofeti phatlalatsa

outcome.label: Botso
options: E tla tuka mo molelong o o tukang
O ne a ikwatlhaya mme a nna molekane
O latlhegetswe ke khumo ya gagwe mme a tlhokafala a tlotlilwe
O ne a tshabela kwa Abisinia
outcome.answer: E tla tuka mo molelong o o tukang

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
